name: Access terminal
description: A white OpenBrain monolith with a black glass front: a screen, a palm scanner, the emblem, and a red light strip down one edge. The campus network's way in.

made_with.settings: smart topology, main view only, textured, PBR

notes: 4,172 triangles; 0.37 x 0.33 m, front facing -Z in Godot (-Y in Blender). Meshy left out the red edge strip, so Claude added it by hand: a 1 cm emissive red bar on the front-left edge. The emblem came through in Meshy's texture, readable up close; the decal from art/reference/openbrain-logo-white.png can replace it if needed. The screen doesn't glow yet. The back view (02-back.png) went unused, as smart topology takes one image.
